steps.text: Talk to Rat Burgiss at the crossing south of Varrock.
chat: 3. Shall I get them back for you?
1. Of course! Tell me what you need me to do.

steps.text: Kill 5 Outlaws just west of the Grand Exchange (from Grand Exchange, use the tunnel and walk south) and collect 5 rat's paper.
Return the folder to Rat Burgiss.
Talk to Surok Magis in the Varrock library (the northern-most room in Varrock Palace).
Enter the Chaos Altar and use the wand on the altar with 15 chaos runes in your inventory.
To avoid entering the wilderness, see an alternative entrance in the full guide.
Return to Surok Magis with the infused wand and an empty bowl.
chat: 1. I have the things you wanted!
1. Yes! I have a letter for you!

steps.text: Bring King Roald to low health (2 hitpoints or less) then operate the Beacon ring. Your chatbox will show "Now would be a good time to summon Zaff!" when the ring is ready to be operated. (Instanced)
Take the Dagon'hai history from the north-east bookshelf to bring to Historian Minas for 5 Kudos after the quest.
